# Quaternius — Modular Dungeon packs (CC0)

Models by Quaternius — https://quaternius.com (released as CC0 1.0 / public domain).
Files taken from the GLB copies in https://github.com/trebeljahr/quaternius-showcase (`public/glb/…`; that
repository's MIT license covers its web code, the models themselves are Quaternius' CC0 packs).
Flat material colours (no textures). Used: Pedestal2, Woodfire, Vase (modular_dungeon_1) and Bones2,
Candelabrum_tall, Column, Column_Broken2, Rock1, Rock2, Rock4, Rock5 (modular_dungeon_pack).
